pages.text: Staying up late? Your body keeps score, meow!$(br2)Staying awake at $(#4b3869)night$() steadily builds $(item)Fatigue$(), and drowsiness follows a circadian rhythm - it peaks around $(#7b68ee)midnight$(). Pull enough all-nighters and you progress: mild -> moderate -> severe -> extreme.$(br2)From moderate on you grow weak, sluggish, get cold hands, crave midnight snacks; from severe you get nauseous, dizzy, hear your heart pounding, may even suffer $(#FF69B4)hallucinations and phantom visits$(), disrupted periods and faster infections...

$(9)Second Wind$()$(br)Deep in the night you may suddenly feel wide awake - don't celebrate. It's your brain burning its last reserves: fatigue builds x3 while it lasts, and the crash after is worse.$(br2)$(4)Sudden death warning$()$(br)Falling asleep mid-step at extreme fatigue is the lucky outcome - cardiac arrest means never waking up. The faster your eyelids close on screen, the closer danger is.$(br2)$(c)And yes, dark circles show on your face for everyone to see.

$(item)Shenbao$() — the night owl's best friend! Eating one instantly removes a chunk of fatigue, and its $(item)Strong$() effect halves further fatigue buildup at night.$(br2)$(gray)One sip of Shenbao for a whole night of good sleep (not really).$()

$(#4b3869)Doctor's tips$()$(br)- Overusing your eyes at night accelerates cataracts.$(br)- Fatigue lowers immunity: urethritis, prostatitis, hemorrhoids and paronychia all progress faster.$(br)- Shaky hands make bad archers - don't expect accuracy past moderate fatigue.$(br)- Hallucinated sounds vary: wolf growls, cats, doors opening, footsteps... Don't turn around; it's probably fake. Probably.$(br)- Nekos are nocturnal - they only build half the fatigue at night.$(br)- The Nether and the End have no day/night cycle; there you count as staying up late all the time.$(br2)$6Early to bed, early to rise, meow~$()
